import sys, hashlib
s = open('/tmp/r29rev/call29.sh').read()
body = s.split("<<'EOF'\n", 1)[1].rsplit('\nEOF', 1)[0]
reps = [("startswith('f26d989f')", "startswith('e5dc8ef0')"),
        ("SRC = dict(r27=live, r28=open(_p.__file__).read())",
         "SRC = dict(r28=live, r29=open(_p.__file__).read())\nassert hashlib.sha256(SRC['r29'].encode()).hexdigest().startswith('866637df')")]
for a, b in reps:
    assert body.count(a) == 1, a
    body = body.replace(a, b)
print('Q3 columns: live r28 | r29', sys.argv[1:])
exec(compile(body, 'q3', 'exec'), dict(__name__='__main__'))
